in_marathi.name: Mallikarjun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Goddess Mallika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mallikarjun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mallikarjun is the name of Lord Shiva, who is the protector and consort of Goddess Mallika, also known as Bhadrakali. The name is a combination of Mallika (Goddess) and Arjun (auspicious, heroic).

The name is a combination of Mallika (Goddess) and Arjun (auspicious, heroic).
